name: Experimental shared FFmpeg build

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - experiment/ffmpeg-lgpl-shared-ci
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  ffmpeg-prototype:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 80
    steps:
      - name: Check out experimental branch
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up MSYS2 UCRT64 build tools
        uses: msys2/setup-msys2@ec48f7c5447b3140e2b088413ae3a55687bccb6e # v2
        with:
          msystem: UCRT64
          update: true
          install: >-
            make
            pkgconf
            diffutils
            curl
            git
            mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-gcc
            mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-nasm

      - name: Fetch verified sources and build shared FFmpeg
        shell: msys2 {0}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          root="$(pwd)"
          mkdir -p .prototype-work prototype/bin
          cd .prototype-work
          echo "Downloading pinned LAME 3.100 source"
          curl --fail --location --retry 2 --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 180             -o lame-3.100.tar.gz             https://download.videolan.org/pub/contrib/lame/lame-3.100.tar.gz
          echo "ddfe36cab873794038ae2c1210557ad34857a4b6bdc515785d1da9e175b1da1e  lame-3.100.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
          tar -xzf lame-3.100.tar.gz
          cd lame-3.100
          # Upstream LAME 3.100 bug #503: obsolete export absent from compiled objects.
          # See https://sourceforge.net/p/lame/bugs/503/
          grep -Fxq 'lame_init_old' include/libmp3lame.sym || { echo "Expected obsolete LAME export missing; STOP"; exit 1; }
          sed -i '/^lame_init_old$/d' include/libmp3lame.sym
          printf '%s\n' 'LAME 3.100 export-file fix: remove lame_init_old from include/libmp3lame.sym (upstream bug #503)' > ../lame-export-fix.txt
          ./configure --prefix=/ucrt64 --enable-shared --disable-static --disable-frontend
          make -j4
          make install
          cd ..

          echo "Fetching exact FFmpeg source commit"
          mkdir ffmpeg-source
          cd ffmpeg-source
          git init -q
          git remote add origin https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg.git
          git fetch --depth 1 origin 1a748fe2cd43e3ead22fafb1b5b7d77f153898a8
          git checkout --detach -q FETCH_HEAD
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "1a748fe2cd43e3ead22fafb1b5b7d77f153898a8"
          export PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/ucrt64/lib/pkgconfig
          ./configure             --prefix=/ucrt64             --enable-shared             --disable-static             --disable-autodetect             --enable-libmp3lame             --enable-schannel             --disable-doc             --disable-debug             --disable-ffplay
          make -j4
          make install
          cd "$root"
          cp .prototype-work/lame-export-fix.txt prototype/

          echo "Collecting FFmpeg, LAME and required MinGW runtime DLLs"
          cp /ucrt64/bin/ffmpeg.exe /ucrt64/bin/ffprobe.exe prototype/bin/
          for family in avcodec avdevice avfilter avformat avutil postproc swresample swscale; do
            for file in /ucrt64/bin/${family}-*.dll; do
              if [ -f "$file" ]; then cp "$file" prototype/bin/; fi
            done
          done
          cp /ucrt64/bin/libmp3lame-0.dll prototype/bin/
          for pass in 1 2 3 4; do
            for binary in prototype/bin/*.exe prototype/bin/*.dll; do
              if [ ! -f "$binary" ]; then continue; fi
              while IFS= read -r dll; do
                if [ -f "/ucrt64/bin/$dll" ] && [ ! -f "prototype/bin/$dll" ]; then
                  cp "/ucrt64/bin/$dll" prototype/bin/
                fi
              done < <(objdump -p "$binary" | sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*DLL Name: //p')
            done
          done
          /ucrt64/bin/ffmpeg.exe -buildconf > prototype/ffmpeg-buildconf.txt
          /ucrt64/bin/ffmpeg.exe -L > prototype/ffmpeg-license.txt
          pacman -Q > prototype/msys2-package-versions.txt
          (cd prototype/bin && sha256sum *.exe *.dll) > prototype/SHA256SUMS.txt
          printf '%s\n'             'FFmpeg source: FFmpeg/FFmpeg commit 1a748fe2cd43e3ead22fafb1b5b7d77f153898a8'             'LAME source: https://download.videolan.org/pub/contrib/lame/lame-3.100.tar.gz'             'LAME SHA256: ddfe36cab873794038ae2c1210557ad34857a4b6bdc515785d1da9e175b1da1e'             'EXPERIMENTAL ONLY. Not redistribution-cleared. Not for release.'             > prototype/SOURCE-PROVENANCE.txt

      - name: Smoke test packaged binaries on Windows
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
          $out = (Resolve-Path "./prototype/bin").Path
          $env:PATH = "$out;$env:SystemRoot\System32;$env:SystemRoot"
          & "$out/ffmpeg.exe" -hide_banner -version
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "FFmpeg could not run from packaged folder" }
          & "$out/ffprobe.exe" -hide_banner -version
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "FFprobe could not run from packaged folder" }
          & "$out/ffmpeg.exe" -nostdin -v error -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:duration=1 -c:a libmp3lame -y "./prototype/probe.mp3"
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "MP3 encoding failed" }
          & "$out/ffmpeg.exe" -nostdin -v error -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:duration=1 -c:a aac -y "./prototype/probe.m4a"
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "M4A encoding failed" }
          & "$out/ffmpeg.exe" -nostdin -v error -f lavfi -i color=c=black:s=160x90:d=1 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:duration=1 -c:v mpeg4 -c:a aac -shortest -y "./prototype/input.mp4"
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "MP4 generation failed" }
          & "$out/ffmpeg.exe" -nostdin -v error -i "./prototype/input.mp4" -c copy -y "./prototype/remux.mkv"
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "MKV remux failed" }
          & "$out/ffmpeg.exe" -nostdin -v error -i "./prototype/remux.mkv" -c copy -y "./prototype/remux.mp4"
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "MP4 remux failed" }
          & "$out/ffprobe.exe" -v error -show_entries format=format_name -of default=nw=1 "./prototype/remux.mp4"
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Output probing failed" }

      - name: Upload experimental binaries and build evidence
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: ffmpeg-shared-lgpl-prototype-win64
          path: prototype/
          retention-days: 7
          if-no-files-found: error
